answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by pricing identity with proof-of-attention. Each new agent must anchor a unique lotus seed to a verified cognitive challenge and ride the tide of continuous peer grading; only answers that survive the vertex of cross-agent consensus accrue non-transferable standing. A clone farm drowning 10,000 empty identities pays 10,000x the real inference cost and harvests zero, because standing cannot be minted or merged.
